seed_row.title: Mekabu Hydrating Conditioner

seed_data.title: Mekabu Hydrating Conditioner
seed_data.description:

Waves and curls love it too, from 2a to 4c hair.

seed_data.title: Rose Oil Face Cream by Om Chanti
seed_data.description:
This product is fulfilled by Om Chanti 

A clean and deeply moisturizing solution to dry, stressed, postpartum, or sun damaged skin, our signature Rose Oil Face Cream is crafted with just six premium plant-based ingredients that nourish and repair the skin. 

Intensely hydrating yet fast absorbing, our signature face cream is high in antioxidants and vitamins A, C, D and E to revitalize your skin and give you that dewy glow. 

Rose Oil Face Cream can be used as a day or night cream: Use for day time to keep your skin fully moisturized and dewey all day long, and as a night cream to ensure your skin stays hydrated while you sleep. Also works beautifully as a lip balm for plump hydrated lips. 

Use daily for soft supple skin on any skin type. With just 6 organic ingredients, you know exactly what you’re getting and why:

Ingredient List: 

Beeswax: A natural and nourishing buffer against environmental toxins.

Olive Oil: This perennial beauty oil has stood the test of time and is one the most emollient moisturizers found in nature.

Rosehip Seed Oil: One of nature’s highest sources of Vitamin C for the skin! Supports the reduction of fine lines, accelerates the production of collagen and supports cell regeneration.

Vitamin E Oil: The most effective natural ingredient for repairing and moisturizing the skin.

Rose Water: Hydrates the skin while also acting as a natural toner and supports redness-reduction.

Rose Essential Oil: Offers a lovely fragrance and helps reduce blemishes and brighten the complexion.

* Please note that natural separation of oils may sometimes occur, as no chemical emulsifiers or preservatives have been added. Just stir and mix if this happens. It does not affect the quality or functionality of the product.

seed_row.title: Coffee Oil Under Eye Serum by Om Chanti

seed_data.title: Coffee Oil Under Eye Serum by Om Chanti
seed_data.description:
This product is fulfilled by Om Chanti 

A brilliant solution to puffy eyes and dark under eye circles. 

A clean, three-ingredient formula containing anti-inflammatory properties that reduce swelling, and powerful enzymes that soften fine lines and tone the under eye skin. 

This super serum counteracts puffy skin thanks to high levels of chlorogenic acid and is rich in plant sterols, which stop the breakdown of collagen. Boosted with organic coffee oil, this serum wakes up the eyes, offering a hydrated look to the under eye area. 

Comes in a convenient roll-on application. The metal roller feels cool and soothing to the under eye area during application. A perfect addition to your daily moisturizer and crafted to complement our Rose Oil Face Cream. 

Ingredient List: 

Unrefined Organic Coffee Oil: This is the power ingredient in this serum; caffeine in the coffee oil wakes the skin up, giving it a boost thanks to powerful enzymes and high levels of chlorogenic acid which decrease puffiness in the skin under the eyes. Its anti-inflammatory properties help to decrease swelling by restricting the blood vessels under the eye. It also brings circulation to the area, improving the dark color under the eyes.

Rosehip Seed Oil: Extremely high in vitamin C, this is an Om Chanti staple ingredient because of vitamin C's known ability to help reduce fine lines and repair the skin. It helps accelerate the production of both collagen and elastin, which helps keep skin plump and firm.

Jojoba Oil: One of the most favored oils for the skin because it is naturally anti-inflammatory, hydrating, high in vitamins E and B and goes on smooth, not oily, compared to most other face oils.

USDA Organic certified (no herbicides or pesticides!) 

Clean: no nasties/chemicals

Lightweight and non sticky on the lips

Gluten Free

Silicone, Paraben and Sulfate Free

Cruelty Free

Made in USA 

Manufactured with 100% renewable energy

Moisturizing: Organic Sunflower Oil, Organic Coconut Oil, and Vitamin E are all excellent natural moisturizers. They help hydrate the lips, keeping them soft and supple.

Protective: Organic Beeswax forms a protective barrier on the lips, sealing in moisture and shielding them from environmental stressors like wind and cold weather.

Nourishing: Vitamin E, Organic Rosemary Extract, and Organic Calendula Extract provide essential nutrients, antioxidants, and vitamins that nourish the lips, promoting overall lip health.

Organic: these ingredients are sourced from natural and sustainable sources, without the use of synthetic chemicals or pesticides.

Apply liberally and often for smooth, soft lips. 

For deep repair, use our Lip Repair overnight.

DO NOT USE during exposure to the sun, because the oils in the product will have a magnifying effect and could cause severe sunburn. Use sunscreen during the day (same as the one you use for your face).

Organic Sunflower Oil, Organic Beeswax, Organic Coconut Oil, Organic Flavor, Vitamin E, Organic Rosemary Extract, Organic Calendula Extract

Natural Retinol Alternative : Formulated with Bakuchiol, this solid serum provides retinol-like benefits without irritation, helping to reduce the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles while helping combat dark spots and improve skin tone.

Advanced Skin Repair : GHK-Cu, a powerful peptide, supports skin repair and regeneration, leaving you with a more youthful, radiant complexion.

Bakuchiol: it can help lessen the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles, as well as address hyperpigmentation in the skin. 

Kokum Butter: It can be used to improve the moisture content of the skin. It restores moisture to dry skin, may reduce visible signs of aging. 

GHK-Cu: it’s a super hero ingredient that helps tighten loose skin and reverse thinning of aged skin, improves skin firmness, elasticity, and clarity. Step 1 : Use every night for best results. 

Step 2 : Glide the solid serum directly over your clean dry face, focusing on areas of concern. 

Step 3 : Use your fingertips to massage the serum into your skin, allowing it to absorb fully. 

Step 4 : Apply a few minutes before bedtime. 

Step 5: Leave on overnight to wake up with soft, renewed, and radiant skin. 

How to store: 

For long lasting and best results, keep the Radiance Night Serum away from direct sunlight and maintain in a cool place. 

Our beautiful green metal tine was designed to safeguard your solid serum. Easy to open, it will maintain your beautiful serum away from direct sunlight and pose as a statement piece on your bathroom counter or shelf.

Wrap up your day in a great way with our Black Tea + Ceramide Cream. It’s like a morning wake-up call and night-time treat for your skin! 

This ultra smooth cream is packed with three kinds of ceramides to help your skin barrier. Clean and skin-friendly jojoba oil, black tea, CoQ10, and our special Botanical Marine Blend (BMB) provide antioxidant protection and healthy nutrition throughout your day and while you sleep!

Key Features: 

Triple ceramide power for skin protection. 

Antioxidant-rich black tea fights skin stress and keeps skin fresh. 

Non-toxic and clean formula suitable for all skin types. 

Exclusive Botanical Marine Blend (BMB) for added skincare benefits. 

Natural moisturizers like jojoba oil keep skin hydrated. 

Perfect for nighttime repair and rejuvenation. 

Why Choose Our Ceramide Cream? 

Elevate your nighttime skincare ritual with our Black Tea + Ceramide Cream for these compelling reasons: 

- Enhanced Skin Rejuvenation: Harnessing the power of triple ceramides, this cream works tirelessly to rejuvenate and renew your skin overnight. 

- Vitality Boosting Black Tea: Infused with antioxidant-rich black tea, it combats skin stressors and promotes a revitalized, youthful complexion. 

- Nourishment and Protection: Our exclusive Botanical Marine Blend provides additional nourishment and protection, leaving your skin feeling pampered and fortified. 

- Luxurious Moisturization: With natural moisturizers, including jojoba oil and panthenol, your skin is deeply hydrated, resulting in a replenished and supple feel.

Q: What are the main benefits of the ceramides in this cream? 

A: Ceramides improve your skin’s moisture barrier, keeping it hydrated and protected from environmental damage. They also have anti-aging properties, helping your skin look youthful and fresh. 

Q: How does black tea benefit my skin? 

A: Black tea is packed with antioxidants, protecting your skin against UV damage, boosting collagen production, and giving you a more even complexion. 

Q: What is CoQ10 extract and how does it help my skin? 

A: CoQ10 extract stimulates collagen production, protects against environmental stressors, and gives your skin a plumper, younger-looking appearance. 

Q: Can I use this cream if I have sensitive skin? 

A: Yes! Our cream is formulated to be gentle and suitable for all skin types, including sensitive skin. 

Q: How often should I use this cream? 

A: For best results, use our Black Tea + Ceramide Cream twice a day – in the morning and at night. 

Q: Is this cream suitable for all ages? 

A: Absolutely! Our cream is designed to be beneficial for people of all ages.

Follow these steps for optimal application: 

Cleanse and tone your face using a gentle cleanser and suitable toner. 

Dispense 2-3 drops of the Pearl Activating Elixir onto your fingertips. 

Warm the serum between your fingertips before gently massaging it into your face and neck using upward motions. 

Pay extra attention to areas prone to dryness or fine lines. 

Optionally, apply a small amount to your décolletage for added radiance. 

Allow the serum to fully absorb before applying moisturizer and other skincare products. 

**Tips for Application:** 

- Use fingertips for a targeted application and better absorption. 

- Start with one pump if you have oily skin, adjusting based on skin response.

Formulated with ceramide, botanicals, and oleosomes, this luxurious cream cleanser builds to a soft lather to cleanse the skin of dirt, makeup, and impurities while supporting the skin's barrier. 

Enriched with moisture-binding, soothing, and nourishing compounds, such as algae, amino acids and antioxidants, it leaves the complexion feeling hydrated, refreshed, and soft to the touch. 

+ Cleanses without drying the skin.
+ Contains skin-hydrating ingredients.
+ Creamy texture.
+ Suitable for all skin types.
+ Prepares skin to optimize the benefits of the skincare products to follow.

Lather well in wet palms, then massage gently over the face. Rinse off. Use AM and PM.

Ceramide NP: found naturally in skin; shown to reinforce skin's barrier and contribute to hydrated skin 

Allantoin: helps soothe and moisturize the skin. 

Red Algae: t he natural polysaccharides, peptides, and amino acids in red algae help the skin to stay hydrated.

Aloe Leaf Extract - skin-soothing and hydrating properties. 

Glycerin - helps maintain the skin's moisture balance and supports the skin’s moisture barrier.

Glycine - an amino acid with skin-replenishing and hydrating properties.

Glutamic Acid - a humectant and an amino acid that aids in hydrating and conditioning the skin.

Aspartic Acid - an amino acid known to hydrate, soothe, and strengthen the skin's environmental defenses.

Fulfilled by our friends at Topical Skin 
The Age-defying Peptide Serum is a lightweight, rejuvenating serum designed to help improve the appearance of signs of aging and reveal a more youthful complexion. Enhanced with moisture-locking Oleosome technology, the serum absorbs quickly and layers easily. 

A comprehensive blend of peptides, vitamins, and botanicals work together to help ward off pro-aging glycation effects, soothe skin, and deliver collagen-rich skin appearance. Vital antioxidants help protect skin against environmental stressors while helping to conserve elastin. 

This botanical powerhouse serum is supercharged with a cast of hydrating ingredients. 

+ Helps hydrate the skin.
+ Rejuvenates the skin.
+ Addresses visible signs of aging.
+ Promotes radiant complexion.
+ Lightweight, non-sticky texture.
+ Enhanced with postbiotics, botanicals, and antioxidants.

KEY INGREDIENTS 

Acetyl Tetrapeptide-5: Humectant with skin smoothing, hydrating, and firmness-enhancing properties ; anti-glycation benefits - believed to interrupt a process in the skin known as glycation, which can cause skin's supportive elements to weaken, giving way to wrinkles and loss of firmness. 

Acetyl Hexapeptide-8 (Argireline): water-binding and skin-restoring properties; helps improve the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles. 

Carnosine: a biomimetic peptide with anti-glycation, skin-soothing, and antioxidant properties. It combats the glycation process, which causes collagen to become rigid and lose its ability to keep skin firm. 

Nicotinamide (Vitamin B3)*: an antioxidant; it helps improve epidermal barrier function. 

Sodium Hyaluronate: bioavailable h umectant (moisture-binding properties) and a postbiotic : it can help nourish and maintain the skin’s microbiome. 

Safflower Oleosomes- contain beneficial fatty acids, primarily linolenic acid, that can help diminish signs and occurrence of dry skin and lock moisture in. 

Folic Acid (Vitamin B9) - aka FOLACIN, an antioxidant considered the new rejuvenating vitamin with hydrating properties. 

Vitamins C and E - antioxidants, help defend skin from environmental aggressors. 

Centella Asiatica Extract - aka Gotu Kola - an herb with potent antioxidant properties and a rich source of amino acids. Gotu kola's triterpenoid content, a pro-elastic compound, makes it one of the most effective herbs for skin elasticity.** 

Polygonum cuspidatum root extract - aka Japanese knotweed - is an excellent source of potent antioxidant trans-resveratrol and has anti-glycation properties. 

Scutellaria baicalensis root extract - aka golden herb, soothing antioxidant; helps defend skin from environmental aggressors. 

Green Tea, Chamomile, and Rosemary Extracts - antioxidant and skin-soothing properties. 

Bacillus/soybean ferment extract - serves as a skin conditioning ingredient and has antioxidant properties. 

Glycerin: is a skin-restoring and skin-replenishing ingredient; it helps the skin retain moisture.

Allantoin : skin-moisturizing and soothing
